name: Go Ascendant
description:
Once per Quest: You assume your Ascendant form. For the next minute:

  • You become incorporeal and emit bright light out to far range.

  • You may spend a half action to alter your form to any shape you choose and becoming any size between ¼ and 10.

  • Your actions increase to 5 per round.

  • You can fly with a Speed of 200 ft.

  • Multiply your current and base Endurance, Hope and Defense by 10.

  • Whenever you make a skill check, roll one fate die and ten success dice, regardless of the number of ranks you have in that skill.

  • Multiply all damage you deal by 10.

  • Prevent all damage dealt to you by non-magical sources. Divide all damage dealt to you by magical sources by 10.

  • You may cast any spell from any Mestiere.

At the end of the minute, these effects end and you check four Conditions.
